title: ShiftWM: Context and Observation Anchoring for Compact World Models
findings: The single 5.3% numerical claim is supported by the completed native 4x4 h10 endpoint comparison against autoregression on original DROID validation; it is labeled development.
Simulated unseen-combination forecast improvements are supported for both PushT and Reacher; this statement does not extend to new-value extrapolation or planning.
Architecture wording matches separate original context and observation-anchored spatial variants. The spatial variant does not retain the original two-context factorization.
No state-of-the-art, universal model/task applicability, real closed-loop benefit, untouched-test claim, RGB-generation claim or acceptance guarantee appears.
Release claim is supported by completed public checkpoint/code/diagnostic artifacts.
nonblocking_precision_note: Ten-step feature error denotes the endpoint at h10, not the average over all ten predictions. The detailed report and manuscript explicitly identify the endpoint/native-grid metric.
title_interpretation: Descriptive family title; no causal benefit is inferred merely from the word context. Spatial context-on versus context-off remains inconclusive.
scope: Editorial claim audit against completed evidence; no new model or metric evaluation performed.
